rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Code Remote enables AI assistants to execute commands on your local machine through a secure relay architecture. The system consists of a cloud-hosted server that exposes MCP tools for shell commands, file operations, and directory listing, paired with a local agent that runs on your machine and executes the actual commands. Commands are queued through WebSocket connections with token-based authentication, and the agent restricts file access to safe directories for security.
